question: Which complete downstream attention or MLP responses carry the 16–18% of the original block8H1 writer effect not reproduced by the known block9 H1/H4 plus block11 H3 reader values?

searched: temporal_auxiliary writer module/head/reader/response prior and result files
prior_art_search.relation: Whole-task component screens exist, and the fresh writer was localized through block11. No writer-specific complete-module response atlas exists for the original cue corpus.

frozen_design.population: all 32 A1 and 32 A2 original rows, both sides natively capable
frozen_design.writer: exact block8H1 cue-source response at the two subject-onset tokens
frozen_design.sites: complete attention and MLP output responses at the final query for blocks 9 through 17
frozen_design.intervention: for each site independently, replace its native-base response with the response captured under the exact writer intervention
frozen_design.new_material_bar: absolute mean site response >=0.05 of the writer effect in both A1 and A2 outside attn:09 and attn:11

predictions.pred_a_authority_capability_and_exact_ca: all authorities match, both sides are correct, exact writer recurrence is within 0.03 of 0.23825/0.14472, and capture identities are <=1e-4
predictions.pred_b_known_attention_readers_are_mater: attn:09 and attn:11 each have positive mean response and jointly are the two largest attention singleton responses in both families
predictions.pred_c_missing_singleton_module_exists: at least one site outside attn:09/attn:11 reaches the registered 0.05 writer-fraction bar in both families
predictions.pred_d_complete_ranked_atlas_reported: all 18 sites have 64 unique finite row records and family summaries

terminal_rules.invalid: authority, capability, writer recurrence, identity, coverage, or price fails
terminal_rules.screen: a new material singleton module is found for head splitting
terminal_rules.null: valid atlas finds no new material singleton; proceed to greedy joint module combinations because the remainder is distributed or interactive

interpretation_limits: Singleton response installation is a localization screen, not a complete mediation decomposition.
If no singleton passes, the registered successor is greedy joint selection over the complete module-response pool, not a lowered threshold.
Head splitting is opened only inside attention modules that pass this screen.
